headline: The FDA has cleared NextMR, a cloud-based AI service that turns an ordinary spine MRI scan into a 3D image of the bones in under a minute.
score_reason: Routine device clearance announced on 7 Oct 2026 with company-only claims; lowered by 1 from 5.
importance_line: Could save some spine-surgery patients extra imaging and radiation, but the speed and benefits are the company's own claims and no accuracy data were given.
summary: Diagnostic Imaging reports, citing the developer MRI2CT, that the FDA has cleared NextMR, which uses AI to create 3D bone images from standard 1.5T and 3T spine MRI scans in under 60 seconds, to help surgical planning. A Chicago spine surgeon quoted in the article says it could spare patients extra imaging, radiation and appointments, which is his view, not a trial result.
notes: Radiology Business page (403) replaced by Diagnostic Imaging, which carries the same MRI2CT clearance on 7 Oct 2026.
